label: Accessible witness preservation rules out being without a source of dependence
description: Re-presentation at the same origin, not independent support for 000e1f65 (#2103). If a dependent effect could exist without its source, realization gives an accessible contrast witness. Preservation supplies a selected accessible contrast witness for the same pair. Dependence soundness excludes the effect there, contradicting its presence. This uses only witness preservation alongside the original realization and soundness premises. With the selector a free parameter, soundness and preservation hold for some selector exactly when 000e1f65 holds with being-without read as accessible contrast, CAN_BE_WITHOUT_1 (Lean track_preserve_iff_strict), so the warrant is that of the accessibility reading plus the realization bridge 11dc5069. Its restates_conclusion marker (#2190) makes the frontier close 000e1f65 through it only by rule (d), when every premise is closed.

restates_conclusion.note: With the selector existentially closed, soundness 2bdb0be1 and witness preservation 31bcb75e hold exactly when 000e1f65 holds at being-without read as accessible contrast (CAN_BE_WITHOUT_1), so these two premises re-present that instance of the conclusion. The realization premise 11dc5069 is not restated: it is the one-way bridge from the conclusion's being-without to accessible contrast. The derivation's warrant for 000e1f65 is that of its accessible-contrast instance plus 11dc5069.
